items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father was a minister in the African Methodist Episcopal Church, the AME Church.

ctx.x: Would you give us your full name, the birth place, and share with us your familial history.

My name is John – J-o-h-n – Carl Hendricks. I was born September 16th, 1921, in Newark, Ohio, the ninth child and the seventh son of Reverend and Mrs. Willie Hendricks. My father was a minister in the African Methodist Episcopal Church, the AME Church.
Who were your brothers and sisters?
